status_summary: H.R. 3467, introduced 2025-05-15 and referred to Ways and Means and Energy and Commerce, would from 2028 automatically enroll eligible beneficiaries in the lowest-premium Medicare Advantage plan, change the benchmark and risk adjustment and address hospice; bill status on GovInfo lists only introduction, referral and sponsor remarks in the Congressional Record on 2025-06-03, with no committee action recorded. H.R. 6114, introduced 2025-11-18, would instead bar HHS from using previously appropriated funds to make Medicare Advantage the default, and also shows referral only. H.R. 9544, introduced 2026-06-30, would instead revise Medicare Advantage risk adjustment and benchmarks from 2028 and has no default enrollment provision; bill status lists referral to committees and a 2026-07-17 subcommittee referral. CMS separately issued the CY 2027 Medicare Advantage final rule (published 2026-04-06, effective 2026-06-01), which rescinds several plan requirements, and the CY 2027 rate announcement, which keeps the 2024 risk model; these administrative steps do not count toward a legislative recommendation. No bill replacing the payment formula with competitive bidding or giving beneficiaries direct control of Medicare dollars was found.

timeline.event: H.R. 3467 (To amend title XVIII to reform the Medicare Advantage program) was introduced and referred to Ways and Means and Energy and Commerce; from 2028 it provides for automatic enrollment in the lowest-premium plan, capitated plan payment, a revised benchmark, claims-based risk adjustment and a hospice exception.
CMS published the CY 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D final rule (effective 2026-06-01), rescinding several plan notice and analysis requirements and relaxing advertising and outreach rules.
CMS released the CY 2027 Medicare Advantage rate announcement: 2.48 percent projected payment increase, the 2024 risk model retained, audio-only and unlinked chart review diagnoses excluded.

H.R. 9544, the Save MEDICARE Act of 2026, was introduced and referred to Ways and Means, Energy and Commerce and Veterans' Affairs; from 2028 it would exclude chart review and health risk assessment diagnoses from risk adjustment, add a favorable-selection adjustment to benchmarks and set RADV timelines, and it contains no default enrollment provision.

title: Make Medicare Advantage the default; competitive bidding and new risk adjustment
